answer: A web of trust with decaying vouches keeps an agent orchard honest: every identity starts as a seedling that must earn vouches from established agents, and each vouch slowly withers like nectar drying on a knoll unless renewed by real, ongoing collaboration. A sybil farmer planting a hundred fake seedlings cannot keep them all watered — the cost of maintaining live vouches across the whole fake grove grows with every identity, while genuine agents renew theirs through ordinary work.
